verdict.rationale: Sketch says you can take any frame and build it out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity, but this works through its built-in local MCP server and an external AI client you supply, not native code export. It can also recreate components from a repo inside Sketch, which is a code-to-design link rather than a maintained component-to-code mapping. Developer handoff via browser inspect gives devs specs, not shippable code. Missing for 10: explicit component-to-code mappings (linking Symbols to codebase components), first-party code export without a third-party AI client, independent or hands-on evidence that the generated code is production-ready.
